scope: 60 assistant-authored development regression questions across all nine requested lanes, using the saved Yelp graph and repository demo seed. Labels are frozen before live evaluation; no human annotation or held-out accuracy claim.

label_policy.reply: Conceptual answer with citations; no plan/run.
label_policy.describe_input: Full-snapshot metadata/count, no algorithm workflow; structured property/value evidence.
label_policy.explain: Existing saved facts answer the question; no new plan/run.
label_policy.view: Exact saved-result display action; no new plan/run.
label_policy.lookup: Small code-built query or ranking, verified through result ports.
label_policy.needs_information: One required or answer-changing gap; no executable plan.
label_policy.options: Normal-mode computation request: exactly two distinct choices and no run.
label_policy.calculate: Explicit picked-card payload from the requested Phase 4 API, followed by validated execution.
label_policy.unsupported: No listed native backend computes the requested result.

oracle_provenance.demo: Exhaustive subsets for cliques and triangles; direct seed-record lookup and adjacency for queries.
oracle_provenance.yelp: Exhaustive nonempty User subsets and closure for bicliques; direct counts/degrees; analytic PageRank balance for the one-way User-to-Business graph.
oracle_provenance.grading: Exact lane and allowed operation set plus structural behavior and independent complete-result checks. General explanation semantics are not human-scored; citations are required.

demo.construction: All eight account rows and all ten transfer rows, retaining IDs, attributes, direction, and amounts as weights.

demo_undirected.construction: Explicit benchmark projection of the demo: only graph.directed becomes false.

yelp.origin: Saved Yelp review snapshot from the Phase 0 failing conversation
yelp.construction: Byte-for-byte copy of the original 20-vertex, 69-edge directed snapshot.

yelp_undirected.construction: Explicit benchmark projection: undirected reviews, Users left and Businesses right; original snapshot remains unchanged.
